content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To improve your game in soccer, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Purchase a high-quality match ball (30 minutes)
Step 2. Research local amateur leagues (2 hours)
Step 3. Register for a weekend tournament (45 minutes)
Step 4. Buy new cleats and shin guards (1 hour)
Step 5. Practice long-distance goal kicks (90 minutes)
Step 6. Attend a team tryout session (3 hours)
Step 7. Watch professional match highlights for strategy (1 hour)
Step 8. Join a local sports gym (1 hour)
Step 9. Consult with a professional coach (1 hour)
Step 10. Participate in a ball-handling clinic (4 hours)
Step 11. Start a high-intensity interval training program (4 weeks)
Step 12. Develop a personalized nutrition plan (3 days)
Step 13. Study the official FIFA rulebook (5 hours)
Step 14. Break in new cleats during light jogging (2 hours)
Step 15. Practice dribbling through cones (1 hour)
Step 16. Watch tutorials on defensive positioning (2 hours)
Step 17. Schedule a physical check-up with a doctor (45 minutes)
Step 18. Practice corner kick accuracy (2 hours)
Step 19. Play in a full 90-minute scrimmage (90 minutes)
Step 20. Perform dynamic stretching routines (20 minutes)
Step 21. Clean and maintain your soccer gear (30 minutes)
Step 22. Complete a stamina-building marathon (4 hours)
Step 23. Perform lower-body strength training (1 hour)
Step 24. Buy a portable practice net (30 minutes)
Step 25. Practice penalty shootouts (1 hour)
Step 26. Master the "Cruyff Turn" maneuver (2 hours)
Step 27. Practice short-distance passing drills (1 hour)
Step 28. Practice one-touch receiving (1 hour)
Step 29. Find a local park with open fields (30 minutes)
Step 30. Join a recreational 5-a-side team (1 hour)
Step 31. Set specific performance goals for the season (2 hours)
Step 32. Watch a live professional soccer game (2 hours)
Step 33. Practice juggling the ball to improve touch (30 minutes)
Step 34. Perform agility ladder drills (45 minutes)
Step 35. Study off-the-ball movement patterns (3 hours)
Step 36. Practice header techniques safely (30 minutes)
Step 37. Review video footage of your own play (2 hours)
Step 38. Buy a heart rate monitor for training (15 minutes)
Step 39. Memorize team set-piece plays (2 hours)
Step 40. Search for online soccer training communities (1 hour)
